meta.name: himalaya
meta.description: CLI to manage emails via IMAP/SMTP. Use `himalaya` to list, read, write, reply, forward, search, and organize emails from the terminal. Supports multiple accounts and message composition with MML (MIME Meta Language).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在终端里管理邮件，收发搜索全搞定
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果习惯用命令行处理邮件，不想开图形客户端
copy.tagline_en: Manage emails from the terminal, list, read, and send
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer command-line email over GUI clients

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过终端命令管理邮件：列出、阅读、编写、回复、转发、搜索和组织邮件。支持多个账户和附件操作。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理邮件（如查看收件箱、发送邮件）时触发。需要先安装 Himalaya CLI 并配置 IMAP/SMTP 账户。

say.text: 帮我列出收件箱中的最新邮件。
say.note: 执行 himalaya envelope list 命令

say.text: 给张三回复一封邮件，内容为“收到，谢谢”。
搜索来自 example@mail.com 的邮件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage emails via terminal commands: list, read, write, reply, forward, search, and organize emails. Supports multiple accounts and attachments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to handle emails (e.g., check inbox, send email). Requires Himalaya CLI installed and IMAP/SMTP account configured.

say_en.text: List the latest emails in my inbox.
Reply to John with 'Got it, thanks.'
say_en.note: Runs himalaya message reply and edits content
Runs himalaya envelope list from example@mail.com
